purpose: Resolve canonical legal projections deterministically from validated fact packages, effective rule versions and an immutable Brain snapshot.

must: select rule versions by legal reference date and as-known-at time
record complete fact, rule, exception and dependency trace
mustNot: mutate canonical rules, facts or projection definitions
embed interface text or consumer-specific HTML
bypass legal or technical review gates
publish a result as legal advice

temporalPolicy.ruleSelection: effective-at-reference-date with optional bitemporal asKnownAt filter
temporalPolicy.dateOnlyOperations: calendar dates without implicit timezone conversion
temporalPolicy.historicalSafety: never default historical cases to the latest rule version

compatibility.legacyProjectionArtifacts: The pre-existing PRJ-* consumer artifacts remain separate from PROJ-* canonical legal projections.
compatibility.migration: No production consumer is switched during Sprint 5.
compatibility.canonicalInterface: executeDomain(request, { brainRoot }) where request conforms to projection-execution-request.schema.json.

runtimeConfiguration.brainRoot: Required host configuration; never part of the legal execution request.
